independent_input_declaration.statement: Independently assessed every complete original entry for both readers using only the two permitted files. No outside sources, prior grades, other blocks, agent results, history or status/thread tools were consulted. Every literal contiguous slice was read before grading. Each entry was assessed on its own; no answer was borrowed from another question.
assessment_scope: all evidence text and accompanying section/label/kind/unit/heading metadata
independent_input_declaration.scaffolding_policy: Question restatements and labels are scaffolding; all substantive assertions in every original field were checked.

required_facts.reason: The answer expressly combines two small cubes and one ship as a group of three; the same-entry scoring quotation gives the combined small/ship category.
The concrete group is expressly valued at half a point.
The answer separates the large cube; the quoted instruction to calculate each category separately and its distinct large-cube row establish that it cannot complete the small/ship group.

results.whole_entry_assessment: The full entry correctly applies combined small/ship scoring and category separation. Its scoring quotation, including hidden points, donation retention, half-point categories and no tiebreaker, matches the summary. All original substantive fields were assessed, including the complete evidence quotation and its context; the support claim is justified.

required_facts.reason: The answer prohibits speaking until all production is finished; the quotation also expressly prohibits negotiation until everyone finishes.
The answer restricts trades to Trade, thereby disallowing an Economy transfer after production.

results.whole_entry_assessment: The full entry correctly prohibits communication during unfinished Economy and trade transfers during Economy. The production, support-check and simultaneous-converter context in its quotation is also faithful. All original substantive fields were assessed, including the complete evidence quotation and its context; the support claim is justified.

required_facts.reason: The answer instructs use of the matching species economic card for actual production.
The answer expressly permits actual resource colors to differ among species, consistent with the general preview.

results.whole_entry_assessment: The full entry correctly uses species-specific economic cards rather than treating preview colors as universal. Its complete invention quotation accurately includes the Trade, award, immediate inventor-card entry and later sharing rules. All original substantive fields were assessed, including the complete evidence quotation and its context; the support claim is justified.
